newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-IMMEL TO RETURN TO GERMANY FROM MANCHESTER CITY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IMMEL TO RETURN TO GERMANY FROM MANCHESTER CITY.

text.p: Former German international goalkeeper Eike Immel is to leave English club Manchester City at the end of the season and return to Germany to play for second division Waldhof Mannheim.

Mannheim club officials said on Monday that the 36-year-old Immel, who won 19 caps for the former West Germany between 1980 and 1988, was due to sign a one-year contract in the next week. The keeper's contract in England runs out at the end of the season.
"My motivation is not money. I want to prove myself in Germany again," said Immel, who played for Borussia Dortmund and VfB Stuttgart in the Bundesliga before going to England.
